meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: Claude 会根据你想做的实验,从 Ginkgo 云端实验室的目录里推荐方案,告诉你价格和需要等多久,再一步步带你完成上传资料、填写要求、提交订单。目录里没有的定制实验,会引导你通过 EstiMate 获取可行性评估和报价。
howto.when: 当用户提到蛋白表达纯化、IVT mRNA/circRNA 合成、热稳定性分析等实验需求,或要求与 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 服务交互时触发。

say.text: 我想做 cell-free 蛋白表达,推荐哪个协议?
say.note: 按目录给出方案、价格与交期。

say.text: 帮我查 Echo-MS 方法建立的价格和交期。
say.note: 会列出价格、交期和所需输入。

say.text: 用 EstiMate 评估我的定制蛋白实验可行性和报价。
say.note: 引导你到 EstiMate 聊天获取评估。

howto.what_en: Claude helps pick a protocol from the Ginkgo Cloud Lab catalog, states pricing and turnaround, and guides you through input upload and order submission. For custom workflows, it directs you to EstiMate for feasibility and pricing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions lab experiments such as protein expression and purification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift assays, and other Ginkgo Cloud Lab services.

say_en.text: I want cell-free protein expression; which protocol do you recommend?
say_en.note: Returns matching protocol, price, and turnaround.

say_en.text: What's the price and turnaround for Echo-MS method onboarding?
say_en.note: Lists price, turnaround, and required inputs.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to assess feasibility and pricing for my custom experiment.
say_en.note: Routes you to the EstiMate chat for an assessment.
